evidence.title: Compliance memo CM-2006-004: phase-out of lead chromate pigments
evidence.claim: In 2006, lead chromate pigments were removed from AF-12 due to OEM customer requirements and the ARAPO regional programme on heavy metals.
evidence.quote: all lead and chromate pigments will be removed from our formulations by 31 December 2006

evidence.title: Compliance memo CM-2006-004: phase-out of lead chromate pigments
evidence.claim: In 2006, zinc phosphate ZP-40 was selected to replace basic lead chromate CL-77 in the AF-12 formulation.
evidence.quote: AF-12: basic lead chromate CL-77 will be replaced by zinc phosphate ZP-40 from Fosfazinco Nord

evidence.title: Supplier qualification SQ-2007-002 - Fosfazinco Nord S.p.A., ZP-40
evidence.claim: In 2007, ZP-40 from Fosfazinco Nord S.p.A. was qualified for AF-12, showing stability and low lead content.
evidence.quote: Material: zinc phosphate anti-corrosive pigment ZP-40, for AF-12.

evidence.title: Supplier qualification SQ-2007-002 - Fosfazinco Nord S.p.A., ZP-40
evidence.claim: In 2007, ZP-40 was approved for AF-12 after salt spray tests showed performance equivalent to the previous CL-77 formulation.
evidence.quote: Anti-corrosion: salt spray 500 h equivalent to the CL-77 formulation.

evidence.title: Compliance memo CM-2003-007 - implementation of D.R. 114/2003
evidence.claim: In 2003, XRF-01 was purchased to screen lead in pigments, specifically for AF-12's use of CL-77.
evidence.quote: XRF analyser XRF-01 purchased (EQ-2003-009). From 1/11/2003 every incoming pigment lot is screened for lead.

evidence.title: QC RELEASE PLAN - QP-02 Batch QC release
evidence.claim: In 2021, XRF lead screening was still required for every incoming pigment lot, including those for AF-12.
evidence.quote: XRF lead screening of every incoming pigment lot.
